what: Round 1228. The format of the three European club cups since 2024-25 (36 clubs in one table, a knockout play-off, a bracket fixed by league position), held as DATA with the pages it was read from. src/lib/uclLeaguePhase.ts states these numbers and scripts/simCmLeaguePhase.mjs section 0 fails if the two disagree. Nothing in the game plays this yet: Round 1228 is libraries only.
rules: verified needs two sources from two publishers on two hosts, none a wiki. The governing body's own regulations count as one publisher.
onePublisher and toVerify rows are marked, never filled, and no constant may stand on them: their usedBy list is empty and section 0 holds that.

A literal is a line the page reader quoted from the page on the read day. A figure a row states is printed, in digits or in words, by two of its publishers, each in a line about that figure. Every number of a competition's shape is a figure of a verified row.

The bracket rule (which play-off pairing feeds which seeded pair, which ties meet in the quarter-finals and the semi-finals) is not typed here. It is DERIVED by section 0 from the two seasons under asPlayed, and the library's slot order must equal what both seasons give.
A source that only repeats another's text counts once.

rows.fact: 36 clubs in one table; each plays eight matches against eight different clubs, four at home and four away.

rows.fact: Four pots of nine by club coefficient, the title holder top of pot one; two opponents from each pot, one at home and one away.

rows.fact: In the league phase draw no club meets a club of its own association, and no club meets more than two clubs of any other one association.

two clubs from the same nation cannot face off in the league phase
no club can play more than two matches against teams from the same country

rows.fact: The real draw has an escape: the administration may adapt a condition to avoid a deadlock. Which condition gives way first is not published, so the order this game relaxes them in is the game's own and no screen may call it UEFA's.

rows.fact: Three points a win and one a draw. 1st to 8th go to the round of 16, 9th to 24th to the knockout phase play-offs, 25th to 36th are out and do not drop into the Europa League.
rows.note: The points for a win and a draw are printed by UEFA alone in words; the second publisher is the arithmetic of ESPN's own tables under asPlayed, where every one of 72 rows has points equal to three times its wins plus its draws. Section 0 checks that.

rows.fact: Level on points, in this order: goal difference, goals scored, away goals scored, wins, away wins, the opponents' points together, the opponents' goal difference together, the opponents' goals together, disciplinary points, club coefficient. No head to head step is in either list.
rows.note: The game keeps no cards and no coefficient for other clubs, so the library applies the first eight and then falls to the club name, and its footnote says so (tableStepsKept).

rows.fact: The play-off: 9th to 16th are seeded against 17th to 24th. 9 or 10 meet 23 or 24, 11 or 12 meet 21 or 22, 13 or 14 meet 19 or 20, 15 or 16 meet 17 or 18. The seeded club is at home in the second leg.

sources.publisher: UEFA, Regulations of the UEFA Champions League 2026/27, Article 19.02

clubs 13 or 14 against clubs 19 or 20, and clubs 15 or 16 against clubs 17 or 18.
In principle, the seeded clubs play the return leg matches at home.
Only the 16 teams that finished in positions nine to 24.
The teams placed ninth to 16th are seeded and will play at home in the second leg, and are listed second.
The teams that finish the league phase between ninth and 16th will be seeded for the first draw for the knockout phase
and will face a team placed 17th to 24th.
Teams ending up ninth and tenth will face the sides that ended 23rd or 24th, for example.

rows.fact: The round of 16. The top eight form four seeded pairs (1 and 2, 3 and 4, 5 and 6, 7 and 8), each club at home in the second leg against a play-off winner. Which play-off pairing feeds which seeded pair is derived from asPlayed: in both seasons 15 to 18 fed 1 and 2, 13, 14, 19, 20 fed 3 and 4, 11, 12, 21, 22 fed 5 and 6, and 9, 10, 23, 24 fed 7 and 8.

rows.fact: From the round of 16 the bracket is fixed to the final: no further draw, and clubs of one association may meet from the play-off on. Which ties meet is derived from asPlayed: in both seasons the tie of the 1 or 2 line met the tie of the 7 or 8 line in the quarter-finals, the 3 or 4 line met the 5 or 6 line, those two quarter-finals met in one semi-final, and 1st and 2nd sat in opposite halves.

rows.fact: The Europa League league phase has the Champions League's shape: 36 clubs in one table, eight matches each, four at home, four pots of nine, two opponents from each pot, the same association rules.
rows.note: The cap of two was first recorded here on the regulations alone (the adversarial review of Round 1228 found it: neither Flashscore nor Crystal Palace prints a cap). goal.com's explainer of the first league phase draw is the second publisher for the cap and for the pots of nine, and section 0 now holds every number of the shape to a figure two publishers print in a line about it.
